messages:
marie_cs: Orbitix go-live heads-up — dedicated pool scheduled Wed 03/12 10:00 PT. Need a concrete plan here for quota windowing, autoscale buffers, and a short ops load-test we can hand to oncall. They expect ~3x baseline traffic for first 2 hours. Can we coordinate in-thread?

vikram_se: Got it. Do we have the traffic profile+95th token length? Also: what's our fallback if the pool saturates — shift to hosted or degrade model?

marie_cs: Paste from Orbitix infra: baseline ~120 req/min, burst to ~360 req/min for analytic jobs; 95p seq len ~1200 tokens. Target p50 gen latency <200ms. They said fallback to hosted is acceptable but would add extra cost; they'd prefer graceful degradation.

lio_oncall: Ops suggestion: run a staggered ramp during bring-up: 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 45m. Keep a 20% autoscale buffer (hot-spare GPUs) and reserve 1 emergency slot for manual routing. If p95 latency >800ms OR error-rate >1.5% for 5min, trigger rollback to lightweight model variant. :warning:

erin_pm: Renewal risk note — if we throttle or they see rate limits day-one, this becomes a billing/regret conversation. Recommend pre-authorizing a small burst budget and a short enablement call with their infra team. I'll own the billing sign-off. :+1:

vikram_se: Proposed autoscale policy (first draft):
- metric: tokens/sec per instance + request queue length
- min_replicas=2, max_replicas=8
- scale_up_cooldown=30s, scale_down_cooldown=120s
- prefer horizontal scale on long sequences (seq_len > 512)
I can push this as a canary config into the deployment.

marie_cs: Nice. I'll run ops load-test Wed 09:00 PT (one hour before go) using this small k6 script — please review and flag anything risky.

```javascript
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function() {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({prompt: 'load test', max_tokens: 512});
  http.post('https://api.redwood.internal/v1/dedicated/orbitix/generate', payload, { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer $TEST' } });
  sleep(0.2); // ~5 RPS per VU
}
```

lio_oncall: @marie_cs +1. Ops will stand by during the 09:00 smoke. We'll watch GPU util, queue length, and the autoscaler events. Add a 1-min rolling check for p95 latency.

autoops-bot: Reserved pool created: orbitix-dedicated-2026-03 (4 x a100-nv4). Console: https://console.internal/redwood/pools/orbitix-dedicated-2026-03/status

marie_cs: Perfect — I'll send the runbook + invite for 09:00 PT now. @vikram_se can you prepare the rollback snippets for the deployment manifest (simple toggle to v1-light)? @erin_pm will confirm the burst budget on billing side. Thanks all! :rocket:
